title: Fellowship
definition: Fellowship is the shared life believers have with God and one another through Jesus Christ.
summary: Christian fellowship is Gospel-shaped life together in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus brings believers into communion with God and unites them as brothers and sisters in His family.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Biblical fellowship is more than friendly conversation or church attendance. It is shared life in Christ. Believers are joined together by the Gospel and called to love, encourage, serve, correct, carry burdens, and pursue holiness together.

Fellowship begins with communion with God through Christ. Because believers share in Christ, they also share responsibility for one another. Fellowship includes worship, teaching, prayer, meals, generosity, confession, encouragement, and mission.

Healthy fellowship helps believers endure. Isolation weakens the soul, but Gospel fellowship strengthens faith and reminds God's people that they do not walk alone.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people are surrounded by people but still spiritually isolated. Fellowship matters because God designed believers to grow in community, not in detached individualism.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pursue real fellowship, not surface-level attendance only. Encourage someone, ask for prayer, carry a burden, confess where appropriate, and look for ways to help others follow Christ.
